items.t: Rebuffed a push by Moore and national Democratic leaders to redraw Maryland's congressional districts.
items.q: As Maryland Senate president, Ferguson rebuffed a push by Moore and national Democratic leaders to redraw Maryland’s congressional districts.

record.t: Announced, with House Speaker Joseline Peña-Melnyk, a special legislative session to consider legislation proposing a constitutional amendment on congressional redistricting standards.
record.q: Senate President Bill Ferguson and House Speaker Joseline Peña-Melnyk announced the special session Tuesday, saying lawmakers will consider legislation proposing a constitutional amendment on congressional redistricting standards.

record.t: Served as Senate Chair of the Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee starting in 2025.
record.q: Member, Executive Nominations Committee, 2019-; Spending Affordability Committee, 2019-. Senate Chair, Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee, 2025-.

record.t: Served as a member of the Governor's Redistricting Advisory Commission starting in 2025.
record.q: Maryland Cybersecurity Coordinating Council, 2022-; Governor's Redistricting Advisory Commission, 2025-.

record.t: Served as Chair of the Senate Vaccine Oversight Workgroup.
record.q: Chair, Senate Vaccine Oversight Workgroup, 2021-2022; Legislative Redistricting Advisory Commission, 2021-2022; Senate Chair, Joint Covid-19 Response Workgroup, 2020

record.t: Was elected President of the Maryland Senate.
record.q: First elected to the Senate in 2010. Member of the Senate since 2011. Elected President of the Maryland Senate, January 8, 2020.

record.t: Served as Co-Chair of the Legislative Policy Committee starting in 2020 and as a member of the Rules Committee.
record.q: Co-Chair, Legislative Policy Committee, 2020- (member, 2019-). Member, Rules Committee, 2020-.

record.t: Served as Senate Chair of the Joint Covid-19 Response Workgroup.
record.q: Senate Chair, Joint Covid-19 Response Workgroup, 2020; Marijuana Legalization Work Group (Chair, ), 2019; Assessment and Funding of School Facilities Workgroup, 2019-2021

record.t: Served as Chair of the Senate Executive Nominations Committee.
record.q: Chair, Senate Executive Nominations Committee, 2017-2018; Pensions Subcommittee, Budget & Taxation Committee, 2015-2019

record.t: Served as Chair of the Local (Video Lottery) Development Council starting in 2014.
record.q: Chair, Local (Video Lottery) Development Council, 2014-; Task Force to Study the Impact of Ocean Acidification on State Waters, 2014-2015

record.t: Served as Senate Chair of the Joint Committee on Transparency and Open Government.
record.q: Senate Chair, Joint Committee on Transparency and Open Government, 2011-14. Member, Joint Committee on Welfare Reform, 2011-14.

record.t: Was first elected to the Maryland Senate.
record.q: First elected to the Senate in 2010. Member of the Senate since 2011.
